scope.evidence: The diff touches only the action, enum, exception, the two required docs, CHANGELOG and the test file; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The winner's status/called_at/called_by_user_id transition is re-implemented inline instead of reusing Ticket::call(), so any future invariant or event added to that primitive could silently diverge from this path.

waitingTicket() and calledTicket() are declared as global functions in a Pest test file; moving them to tests/Pest.php (or guarding with function_exists) avoids fatal redeclaration if another test file uses the same names.
Fairness history is tested for called_at ordering but not for the id tie-break required when two calls share the same called_at, so that specific ordering detail remains unverified.

review.summary: Adds App\Actions\CallNextTicket with CallMode and NoWaitingTicketsException, implementing deterministic priority/age/id ordering, mode-specific selection, the 3-consecutive-priority fairness rule, inactive-queue rejection and exactly-once locking, plus updated docs, CHANGELOG and a thorough Pest test file. Requirements and conventions are fully covered and the tests are strong; the only concerns are nits around reusing Ticket::call(), global test helper functions, and the untested id tie-break in the fairness history, so I would approve with nits.
